en: A colored panoramic view of a small historic town nestled among hills and greenery. In the left background there is a church with a tall spire and adjacent large buildings on a rocky elevation, while in the foreground and middle ground there are many red‑roofed houses and multi‑story town buildings, with a few factory chimneys visible. The landscape stretches into a wide, lightly populated plain under a clear sky. The printed title at the top left reads "Leisnig i. S."
